aboutPage.title: About MatchOp
aboutPage.subtitle: Revolutionizing opportunities for Tunisian talent.
aboutPage.description: Founded by full-stack developers and leadership speakers Iheb Massabi and Zied Fatnassi, MatchOp bridges the gap between ambitious Tunisian graduates and high-quality internships worldwide. We built this AI-driven platform from our own frustrations - struggling to find meaningful opportunities despite our skills and drive.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Empower every Tunisian student to unlock their potential through bias-free, skill-focused matching. No more endless applications or gatekeepers - just real connections with companies that value excellence.

whyStarted.title: Why We Started
whyStarted.description: As entrepreneurs who have spoken on stages about leadership and innovation, we mastered full-stack development but hit roadblocks finding roles that matched our potential. Today, MatchOp delivers verified, high-quality job offers so new graduates land internships and jobs faster - locally and globally.

globalImpact.title: Global Reach, Local Impact
globalImpact.description: We connect Tunisia's brightest minds with remote international opportunities. Skills know no borders, and neither do we. Every student and company on our platform is verified for trust and quality.

cta.subtitle: Find your next career move with MatchOp.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.body: At MatchOp, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our job matching platform.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.personalBody: We collect information you provide directly, including:
collection.usageBody: We automatically collect certain information when you use our Platform:

items.provideImprove: Provide and improve our matching services
items.facilitateConnections: Facilitate connections between students and companies
items.notifications: Send notifications about matches and messages
items.analytics: Analyze usage patterns to improve the Platform

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.body: We may share your information with:

items.otherUsersBody: Profile information is visible to potential matches
items.providersBody: Third parties who help us operate the Platform
items.legalBody: When required by law or to protect our rights

sharing.noSell: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.body: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure servers, and regular security assessments. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

items.access: Access and download your personal data
items.delete: Delete your account and associated data

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.body: MatchOp is not intended for users under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 16.

international.title: 9. International Users
international.body: If you access MatchOp from outside our country of operation, your information may be transferred to and processed in different jurisdictions.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on our Platform and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: Contact Us

whatAre.title: 1. What Are Cookies
whatAre.body: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the site owners. Cookies allow a website to recognize your device and remember information about your visit, such as your preferences and settings.

howUse.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
howUse.body: MatchOp uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform. Specifically, we use cookies to:

items.authenticateBody: Keep you signed in securely as you navigate between pages
items.rememberBody: Store your language, theme, and display settings
items.performanceBody: Understand how you interact with our platform so we can optimize speed and reliability
items.analyzeBody: Gather anonymized data about traffic patterns and feature adoption
items.securityBody: Detect and prevent fraudulent activity via CSRF tokens and session validation

types.title: 3. Types of Cookies We Use
types.essentialBody: These cookies are strictly necessary for the operation of our platform. They enable core functionality such as authentication, session management, and security features. Without these cookies, the platform cannot function properly. Essential cookies cannot be disabled.
types.functionalBody: Functional cookies allow us to remember choices you make on the platform, such as your preferred language, theme (light or dark mode), and other display preferences. These cookies enhance your experience but are not strictly necessary for the platform to operate.
types.analyticsBody: We may use analytics cookies to collect anonymized information about how visitors use our platform. This helps us understand which pages are most popular, how users navigate between pages, and where we can improve. All data collected by analytics cookies is aggregated and anonymous.

duration.title: 4. Cookie Duration
duration.body: Cookies used on MatchOp fall into two categories based on their lifespan:

items.sessionBody: Temporary cookies that are deleted when you close your web browser. These are primarily used for authentication and security.
items.persistentBody: Cookies that remain on your device for a set period of time or until you manually delete them. These are used to remember your preferences across visits.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.body: Our platform may use third-party services - such as Supabase for authentication and database management - that set their own cookies. These third-party cookies are governed by the respective privacy policies of those services. We do not control or have access to third-party cookies.

managing.title: 6. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managing.body: You have full control over the cookies stored on your device. Most web browsers allow you to manage cookies through their settings. You can:

items.viewDelete: View and delete cookies that are already stored on your device
items.block: Block all cookies or only third-party cookies
items.notify: Configure your browser to notify you when a cookie is being set
items.autoClear: Set your browser to automatically clear cookies when you close it
items.note: Please note that disabling essential cookies may prevent you from using certain features of the platform, including signing in and accessing your account.

changes.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legislation, or our data practices. When we make significant changes, we will notify you by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.prefix: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this policy, please contact us at:
